teacher.architecture: ResNet18 -> Linear512/256 -> L2 embedding; CE classification used unnormalized pre-embedding
teacher.pca_original: GT ARI computed in 256D; DINO displayed ARI and Qwen ARI/NMI hardcoded; final original comparison PCA fit GT+generated.
teacher.overlap_evidence: Reconstructed from saved holdout_works and available original CSV; checkpoint did not save input hashes or exact training image IDs
teacher.work_caveat: work_id is a source-directory proxy, not verified artwork identity

protocol: PCA fit GT only; all reported clustering uses original L2-normalized 256D, never PCA2D
background: white: grayscale, removes first .08 ink intensity; ink_match uses fractional morphology to match paired GT mass and changes geometry
limitations: Reference work labels are directory proxies; original training CSV/hash not stored in checkpoint.
ARI measures label clustering, not distribution realism. Unbiased MMD2 may be negative.
P2/Deep/Qwen targets matched exactly; Deep uses P2 STD/noise and may see a condition-domain shift.

Deep114.caveat: Path-based overlap, not a guarantee of pixel/near-duplicate disjointness
